scope: CVG-004 bounded tenant-scoped scheduled registration-services report source through the real worker

criteria.description: The existing registration-services catalog contract is preserved with exactly six fields, strict date filters, deterministic ordering, a 10,000-row bound and explicit exclusions.
criteria.limitations: The contract is bounded to the existing persisted services fields and does not establish full Vetus report parity or any excluded report family.

criteria.description: The shared services source uses explicit tenant context and predicate, an explicit projection, inclusive UTC createdAt bounds, deterministic order, row validation and a fail-closed 10,001-row query limit.
criteria.limitations: The source proof is local/disposable; target RLS/runtime roles, production scale and operational database acceptance remain outside the gate.

criteria.description: The worker composes the shared database source, validates schedule filters and source responses, maps exactly six fields and retains existing scheduled job and one-shot semantics.
criteria.limitations: Continuous/distributed worker operations and delivery providers are not certified by this bounded gate.

criteria.description: Fresh disposable PostgreSQL process evidence proves two-account run-once isolation, exact rows, date selection, null/status mapping, durable execution and non-PII audit.
criteria.limitations: The process uses disposable local PostgreSQL and mock email; it does not certify target roles, provider delivery, external systems or production behavior.

criteria.description: Intentional RED/GREEN, focused regressions, builds, typechecks, security, formatting and diff hygiene satisfy the bounded repository quality bar.
criteria.limitations: Validators are local; remote CI, coverage policy, target operations, external homologation and release acceptance remain open.

criteria.description: A fresh independent post-GREEN review was attempted but no verdict was obtained; the limitation is retained rather than represented as approval.
criteria.limitations: Obtain a fresh independent post-remediation review before higher-confidence use or scope expansion.

criteria.description: The bounded result is reconciled without promoting CVG-004, general Vetus parity, clinical parity, enterprise readiness, target operations or release acceptance.
criteria.limitations: Global parity, clinical parity, enterprise readiness, target operations, provider/fiscal homologation and release acceptance remain open.

gaps: No independent post-GREEN reviewer verdict was available; the limitation is explicit and not treated as approval.
